adjudication.rationale: In the new code, `Discourse.Group#findMembers` (app/assets/javascripts/discourse/models/group.js) performs `Discourse.ajax(...).then(...)` without any error handling, and routes/controllers now invoke it without returning/awaiting the promise (e.g. `setupController` in admin_group_route.js calls `model.findMembers();` and does not return it). This is a behavioral change from the prior `afterModel` hook that returned the promise. If the request fails, nothing sets `members`/`user_count` and there is no error surfaced by the route, so the UI can render an empty members list while `user_count` remains at its default 0 with no error message.
